 RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026, Download Link, Release Date
 RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026 i s scheduled to be released on October 23, 2026 , for candidates appearing in the Computer-Based Test under CEN 04/2026. The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) will conduct CBT 1 on October 27 and 28, 2026, across various centers. Candidates can access their e-call letter on their respective regional RRB portals using their registration number and date of birth.

 RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026: The Railway Recruitment Boards (RRBs) publish the RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026 for candidates taking the first-stage Computer-Based Test for 4,029 vacancies, including Junior Engineer (JE), Depot Material Superintendent (DMS), and Chemical & Metallurgical Assistant (CMA) posts under CEN 04/2026. The admit card acts as an official e-call letter containing mandatory details such as roll number, exam center address, shift timings, and reporting guidelines.
 RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026 e-call letter download link will be activated on October 23, 2026 , on official regional RRB websites approximately 4 days prior to the examination date.
 RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026 – Latest Update
 As per the revised schedule notification released by the Railway Recruitment Boards, the first-stage CBT examination under CEN 04/2026 is scheduled for October 27 and 28, 2026. The exam city and date intimation slip is available from October 17, 2026, allowing candidates to review their allocated exam city and shift before downloading the official hall ticket. RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026 e-call letter download link will be activated on October 23, 2026.

 How to Download RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026
 Candidates can follow these steps to download the e-call letter from the official portal:
 Visit the official portal of your respective regional Railway Recruitment Board (e.g., rrbcdg.gov.in, rrbald.gov.in) or rrbapply.gov.in.
 Click on the notification link titled " CEN 04/2026 – Download CBT 1 Admit Card / E-Call Letter ".
 Enter your Registration Number and Date of Birth (DD/MM/YYYY) on the candidate login page.
 Enter the security CAPTCHA code shown on the screen.
 Click Login / Submit to open your candidate dashboard.
 Click on the Download E-Call Letter option to view your admit card PDF.
 Verify all details and print at least two hard copies on A4 paper for exam day.
 Details Mentioned on RRB JE CBT 1 Hall Ticket
 Verify the following details printed on your RRB JE CBT 1 Hall Ticket 2026 immediately after downloading
 Candidate Information: Full Name, Father's Name, Roll Number, Registration Number, Category, and Gender.
 Photograph & Signature: Uploaded candidate photo and digital signature preview.
 Exam Details: Assigned Post Name (JE / DMS / CMA), CBT Stage, Exam Date, Shift Timing, Gate Closing Time, and Reporting Time.
 Venue Information: Examination Center Name, Full Postal Address, Center Code, and Landmark.
 Exam Day Guidelines: Important instructions regarding document verification, biometric attendance, and banned items.
 Login Credentials Required to Download the Admit Card
 Accessing the e-call letter portal requires two primary credentials specified during the online application process:
 Registration Number: Unique identification number assigned upon submitting the online application form.
 Password / Date of Birth: Enter date of birth in DD/MM/YYYY format.
 If you forget your registration number, check your registered email inbox or SMS inbox for the confirmation message sent during registration. Alternatively, use the "Forgot Registration Number" recovery link on the official portal by submitting your registered mobile number, email ID, and date of birth.
 RRB JE CBT 1 Admit Card 2026 Exam Day Guidelines
 Follow these official instructions to ensure a hassle-free verification process at the examination venue:
 Mandatory Documents to Carry
 Printed Admit Card: Clean printout of the RRB JE CBT 1 e-call letter.
 Valid Photo ID Proof (Original): Aadhaar Card / E-Aadhaar print, Voter ID, Passport, PAN Card, Driving License, or Government Employee ID.
 Passport Photographs: Two recent colour passport-size photographs matching the one uploaded in the application form.
 Category Certificate (if applicable): Travel pass authority for SC/ST candidates utilising free rail transportation.
 Prohibited Items Inside Exam Hall
 Electronic gadgets (mobile phones, smartwatches, Bluetooth devices, earphones, calculators).
 Paper sheets, revision notes, books, or log tables.
 Metallic items, belts, wallets, and bags.
 What to Do If You Cannot Download the RRB JE Admit Card?
 If you face technical issues or errors while retrieving your hall ticket, follow these troubleshooting steps:
 Server Overload: High server traffic can cause slow loading times. Retry after a few minutes or clear your browser cache.
 Invalid Credentials Error: Double-check your Registration Number and ensure Date of Birth is entered correctly in the DD/MM/YYYY format.
 Discrepancy in Details: If there is a spelling mistake or incorrect photo on your admit card, contact your respective regional RRB helpdesk immediately via official helpline numbers or email.
 Rejected Application: Ensure your candidate application status was marked "Accepted" during the official application status verification window.
